newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-GRAF OUT FOR FOUR WEEKS, WILL MISS FED CUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF OUT FOR FOUR WEEKS, WILL MISS FED CUP.

text.p: Steffi Graf announced on Friday she will be out of tennis for the next four weeks with a recurrent left knee injury, missing a Federation Cup tie and events in Indian Wells and Key Biscayne.

Graf, who had to pull out of the Pan Pacific final in Tokyo three weeks ago with the same injury, told reporters she had been ordered not to pick up a racket for four weeks because of an inflammation of the patella tendon.
World number one Graf had been due to play in Germany's first round Federation Cup tie against the Czech Republic on March 1 and 2 in Mannheim, not far from her home town of Bruehl.

"I really wanted to play on my own doorstep. The fact that I'll be missing obviously isn't that good for the event," said the Wimbledon, U.S. and French Open champion, who will also be unable to defend her titles in Indian Wells starting on March 3 and Key Biscayne beginning on March 17.

"Maybe I could have managed to play by hook or by crook, in spite of the injury, but I really want to avoid the kind of setbacks I had in Tokyo or (pulling out of the semifinal in October) in Leipzig," she said.

Graf's absence from the two U.S. tournaments means she may be in danger of ending her record-breaking run as world number one, and have to make way in April for Switzerland's 16-year-old Australian Open champion, Martina Hingis.
Graf said she was determined to be fit for the start of the European clay court season, adding: "My main goals are of course the French Open and Wimbledon."
